name: Ambassador: cat representative (inner ring)
author: Steambirds Revive
description: Summoned by the Ambassador under 30% health (3 of them, the pink ufosaucer). Fixed to the Ambassador's body 4.5 units from its center, it turns with it. It faces the way it circles (faceForward); in the last phase the boss turns counter-clockwise, so its left side is toward the boss and its side guns (the big slow circles, mounts at -90 and 45 degrees) fire through the boss and out the other side: as the boss turns, the bullets draw a spiral. Shielded until the 3 cats of the outer ring are dead. Reconstruction from a video.
